about:
C & G Custom Woodworks operates from Millbrook, Alabama, as a small custom woodworking shop. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are the names of its founders. The business presents itself as a hands-on operation focused on craftsmanship and personal attention, with weekday hours from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. for walk-in consultations.

The shop produces architectural millwork, windows, doors, and curved mouldings, along with hardwood flooring and bar fixtures. It also specializes in historical restoration, working with exotic woods, heart pine, and mahogany for entryways, doors, and mouldings, and incorporates restoration glass. Joinery relies on traditional mortise-and-tenon techniques. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The company serves clients seeking custom architectural woodwork, historical restoration, and bespoke fixtures for residential and commercial projects. Specific industries or named customers are not listed.

C & G emphasizes reasonable pricing, great service, and the use of timeless techniques such as mortise-and-tenon joints to deliver pieces that complement a variety of lifestyles.
